description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GLAccountNotFoundException' used within the Fineract project to handle cases where a General Ledger account resource is not found. It extends the 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' to provide specific error messages based on account ID or GL code.

classes.name: GLAccountNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception thrown when a General Ledger account resource cannot be found, either by ID or by code. It provides constructors for different scenarios and message formatting.

methods.name: GLAccountNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructs exception with a message indicating the GL account ID is invalid.

methods.name: GLAccountNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs exception with a message including the account ID and wraps underlying DAO exception.

methods.name: GLAccountNotFoundException(String glCode)
methods.description: Constructs exception indicating that a GL account with the given code does not exist.

methods.name: super
methods.description: Call to superclass constructor to initialize the exception with message templates and parameters.

calls: super("error.msg.glaccount.id.invalid", "General Ledger account with identifier " + id + " does not exist ", id)
super("error.msg.glaccount.id.invalid", "General Ledger account with identifier " + id + " does not exist ", id, e)
super("error.msg.glaccount.code.invalid", "General Ledger account with GlCode " + glCode + " does not exist ", glCode)
